paite: Judah Kumpipa Ahaziah tapa Joash kum sawmnih-le-thum alal kum in Jehu tapa Jehoahaz Israelte tung ah Samaria ah alal pan a, kum sawm-le-sagih alal hi.
heading: Israel Kumpipa Jehoahaz

paite: TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoih lou mahmah ahih a, Israelte thil hihkhialsak a, ahih Nebat tapa Jeroboam khelhnate ama'n leng ahih samta a, apaisan nawn kei.
Israelte tung ah TOUPA aheh mahmah a, huchi in Siria kumpipa Hazael khut leh Hazael tapa Ben-hadad khut ah adamsung teng ape vekta hi.
Jehoahaz in TOUPA kiang ah nget chihtak in angen a, TOUPA'N athu angaihkhiaksak a; Israel simmoh a om a, Siria kumpipa'n amau asimmohdan lah amu kilkel ngal a.
Huchi in TOUPA'N Israelte hondampa apia a, huchi in Siriate nuai a pan apawtkhia uh. Israel suante tuma lam bang in amau inn ah a-om kinken uhi.
Himahleh Israelte thil ana hihkhialsak a Jeroboam inkote khelhnate apaisan kei ua, ahih lailai zosop ua; Samaria ah Asherah song leng a-om lailai hi.
Jehoahaz in amite lak a sakol tungtuangmi sawmnga, kangtalai sawm leh sepaih singkhat chih louh aneih aphalsak ngal kei a; Siria kumpipa'n ahihmang vek a, leivui chilzan bang in abawl hi.
Huchi in Jehoahaz tanchin dangte, athilhih tengtengte, athilhihtheihdante Israel kumpipate khangthubute ah gelh ahi kei maw?
Hichi in Jehoahaz bel api-le-pute kiang ah a-ihmuta a; Samaria ah avui ua; asik in atapa Jehoash alalta hi.
Judah kumpipa Joash kum sawmthum-le-sagih alal kum in Jehoahaz tapa Jehoash Israelte tung ah Samaria ah alal pan a, kum sawm-le-guk alal hi.
heading: Israel Kumpipa Jehoash

paite: TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoih lou pipi ana hih a; Israelte thil hihkhialsak a ahih Nebat tapa Jeroboam khelhna tengteng apaisan kei a, aching lailai zosop hi.
Huchi in Jehoash tanchin dangte, athilhih tengteng, Judah kumpipa Amaziah toh akisual lai ua athilhihtheihdante Israel kumpipate khangthubute ah gelh ahi kei maw?
Huchi in Jehoash api-le-pute kiang ah a-ihmuta a; Jeroboam alaltutphah ah atu a, Jehoas bel Samaria ah Israel kumpipate lak ah avui uhi.
Elisha achi ana a, sihpih ding khop chinatna ahi. Huchi in akiang ah Israel kumpipa Jehoash ahohsuk a, akah a, "Aw, ka pa, ka pa, Israelte kangtalai leh sakol tungtuang mite," achi hi.
heading: Elisha Sihna

paite: Elisha in akiang ah, "Thalpeu leh thaltangte hon la in," achi a; ama'n thalpeu leh thaltangte ahon la hi.
Israelte kumpipa kiang ah, "Thalpeuh tung ah na khut nga in," achi hi. Huchi in akhut anga a; Elisha in kumpipa khut tung ah akhut anga hi.

Ama'n, "Suahlam tohlet hong in," achi hi. Huchi in ahong hi. Elisha in, "Kap in," achi a, akap hi. Ama'n, "TOUPA hotkhiakna thaltang leh Siria a pan hotkhiakna thaltang; Aphek ah na zoh tanpha in Siriate na sual ding hi,” achi hi.
"Thaltangte hon la in," achi a, Israel kumpipa kiang ah, "Huai in leitual sun dih," achi a; huchi in thumvei asun a, atawpta hi.
Huchi in Pathian mipa atung ah aheh a, "Ngavei ahihkeileh gukvei na sut ding ei ve; huchi in Siriate mangthang vek khop in na zou ding. Himahleh Siriate thumvei kia zou ding na hita ve," achi hi.
Huchi in Elisha asi a, avui uh. Kum hong kivei in, Moab pawlte'n agam uh ahong dou uhi.
Mi khat avui laitak un hichi ahong hi a, ngai in, mi pawl khat amu uhi. Huchi in huai mi Elisha han sung ah akhe mawk ua; aluang in Elisha guhte asukkhaktak in, ahong hing nawn a, adingtouta hi.
Siria kumpipa Hazael in Jehoahaz damsung teng in Israelte anuaisiah hi.
heading: Israel Leh Siria Kal A Kidouna

paite: Himahleh TOUPA'N Abraham, Isak leh Jakob kiang a thu akhun ziak in amau ahehpih a, alainat a, azahtak a, amau ahihmang nuam kei a, akiang a pan apaikhe kei hi.
Siria kumpipa Hazael asi a; asik in atapa Ben-hadad alal hi.
Jehoahaz tapa Jehoash in Hazael tapa Ben-hadad in apa Jehoahaz adou a, khua alaksakte asut nawn a, Joash in thumvei azou a, Israel gam khuate alakik nawn hi.
